item.title: A Pennsylvania court says police can sift through Google searches to find suspects
item.description: In the case of Commonwealth v. Kurtz, Pennsylvania state police obtained a warrant to review Google's search data for the week before a woman was abducted from her home and raped. The warrant raises questions regarding the Fourth Amendment because it did not focus on a specific suspect.Read Entire Article
